description: This PHP source file defines a class 'sendEmail' responsible for creating and sending email drafts with optional PDF attachments within the SuiteCRM system. It interacts with other modules like Emails and Contacts, and contains the main method 'send_email' that consolidates email creation and sending logic.

classes.name: sendEmail
classes.description: A class that handles composing and sending email drafts with optional PDF attachments in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: send_email
methods.description: Creates an email draft, optionally attaches a PDF note, and redirects to the email compose view. Deprecated in favor of EmailController::composeViewFrom.
